description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of the Git pager functionality, including configuration, environment overrides, command-specific settings, and external command interactions. It contains test cases for validating pager usage in various scenarios.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for test expectations and commands, setting global variables for the test framework.

methods.name: colorful
methods.description: Detects whether a given log file contains color codes based on ANSI escape sequences.

methods.name: test_default_pager
methods.description: Tests that the default pager is used when expected.

methods.name: test_PAGER_overrides
methods.description: Tests that the PAGER environment variable overrides the default pager.

methods.name: test_core_pager_overrides
methods.description: Tests repository core.pager configuration overriding the default.

methods.name: test_local_config_ignored
methods.description: Verifies behavior when local repository configuration is ignored.

methods.name: test_core_pager
methods.description: Tests core.pager configuration with different settings based on the repository configuration.

methods.name: test_core_pager_subdir
methods.description: Tests core.pager configuration in a subdirectory, ensuring local configs override global.

methods.name: test_no_local_config_subdir
methods.description: Verifies that subdirectory configs are ignored when configured accordingly.

methods.name: test_GIT_PAGER_overrides
methods.description: Checks that GIT_PAGER environment variable overrides core.pager configuration.

methods.name: test_doesnt_paginate
methods.description: Verifies that certain commands do not invoke a pager as expected.

methods.name: test_pager_choices
methods.description: Runs a suite of tests to validate various pager configurations and overrides.
